title: Detailed toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Toothbrush handle -->
  <rect x="40" y="35" width="14" height="55" rx="7" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <rect x="40" y="35" width="14" height="55" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="#a8e0f5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Handle grip details -->
  <rect x="42" y="60" width="10" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4a9fbf"/>
  <rect x="42" y="68" width="10" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4a9fbf"/>
  <rect x="42" y="76" width="10" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4a9fbf"/>
  <!-- Handle highlight -->
  <rect x="43" y="40" width="3" height="45" rx="1.5" fill="#b8eaf8"/>
  <!-- Neck connecting handle to head -->
  <rect x="43" y="26" width="8" height="12" rx="2" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <rect x="43" y="26" width="8" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#a8e0f5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Toothbrush head -->
  <rect x="38" y="10" width="18" height="20" rx="5" fill="#e86464"/>
  <rect x="38" y="10" width="18" height="20" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#ff9090" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <rect x="40" y="12" width="3" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#ffa0a0"/>
  <!-- Bristle base -->
  <rect x="37" y="6" width="20" height="6" rx="2" fill="#f5f5f5"/>
  <rect x="37" y="6" width="20" height="6" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Bristles row 1 -->
  <rect x="38" y="0" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect x="43" y="0" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <rect x="48" y="0" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect x="53" y="0" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <!-- Bristles row 2 (slightly shorter) -->
  <rect x="40.5" y="2" width="2.5" height="5" rx="1" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <rect x="45.5" y="2" width="2.5" height="5" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect x="50.5" y="2" width="2.5" height="5" rx="1" fill="#e0e0e0"/>
  <!-- Toothpaste dollop on bristles -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="4" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#66dd88" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="3.5" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#88ffaa" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Sparkle near toothpaste -->
  <circle cx="54" cy="3" r="1.2" fill="#ccffdd"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="1" r="0.8" fill="#ccffdd"/>
</svg>
